subject: Order confirmation hiccup
text:
Hi folks,

just nudging about that new sound mixer we all chip in for, because I bought it yesterday and I want to make sure nobody feels out of the loop. The checkout worked okay, but the order confirmation page kept spinning after I hit pay, so I refreshed a couple of times and panicked a little. Then my card showed two charges for a few minutes, which was annoying, and I thought the site might be acting up. Luckily one charge dropped off, but I still cannot see the invoice in the account area. I emailed support and opened a ticket, just in case it needs a manual refresh. If anyone wants to see the receipt, I can drop it in the group chat once the portal stops being stubborn. I do think the item is fine, the shop has good reviews, and the specs look right for our monthly meetings. Also, I might have entered the club name instead of my own name at one point, which explains why my login does not show it cleanly. No need for everyone to respond at once, but if anyone has used this store before, tell me whether the pending charge usually disappears the same day. I will keep watching the bank statement through tomorrow, so if it stays weird I can call and ask them to void the hold too and maybe get it sorted faster. Anyway, thanks for trusting me with the purchase, and I will post a picture as soon as it lands.
